Member.title: Member
Member.description: A club member tracked in the shared SKAS KGKT payment system.

memberName.description: Uppercase display name of the club member.

ownerId.description: Workspace identifier for cross-device sync (e.g. skas_kgkt_shared).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the member record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member record was last updated.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: A monthly membership fee payment record for a specific club member.

memberId.description: Document ID of the associated member in the /members collection.

memberName.description: Uppercase display name of the club member.

months.description: Comma-separated list of months covered by this payment.

feeAmount.description: Total fee amount paid in dollars.

paymentDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the payment was recorded.

ownerId.description: Workspace identifier for cross-device sync (e.g. skas_kgkt_shared).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the payment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the payment record was last updated.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: An income or expense transaction in the club budget ledger.

transactionType.description: Whether the transaction is income or expense.

category.description: Uppercase category label for the budget transaction.

description.description: Uppercase description of the budget transaction.

transactionDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the transaction.

ownerId.description: Workspace identifier for cross-device sync (e.g. skas_kgkt_shared).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was last updated.

clubTitle.description: Display title of the club organization.

pageTitle.description: Subtitle of the payment and expense tracker.

buttonText.description: Custom label for the primary payment submission button.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the config was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the config was last updated.

/members/{memberId}.description: Stores club members synced across all devices.

/payments/{paymentId}.description: Stores monthly membership fee payment records linked to a member.

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: Stores club budget income and expense ledger transactions.
